command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e (spawn#707); the body is staged, not inlined
# (EC2 user data is capped at 16 KiB, spawn#1063).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
printf 'b872a8837a7b4675120ddb3119dae9f1e1d00d67bfb5164e9a56ad28bc6060d5  recount\n2b4151a480f1ef4254b52964f9e3de407dfaa5ca5880c6f6f4446b3c9226b74c  reference.sh\n106925db5774e106cbd2eef33e70b0e59321409ab4b28dc15484c398f5afc55e  pins.sha256\n0813248a84f875de50735866461cde046dde1cd994d520a03bfefd414f19c32f  fragments.tsv.gz\n5267f3afe6426e9f010957d46a50ebb97ab629167e2d1d76576afbf7b2be9f93  peaks.bed\nd4fd832aafc71a364d1cb7e89f8449ce0a245a349407782e335cf2ba8687a525  cells.txt\n216e21dfea6318d019a02e3fb76a15c1d51a537bf114fa9ff287dd96785b345f  genes.tsv\n' > inputs.sha256
sha256sum -c inputs.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
bash /tmp/reference.sh > reference.log 2>&1; RC=$?
cat reference.log
test "$RC" = 0 && grep -q '^REFERENCE OK' reference.log || { echo "FAIL: reference.sh exited $RC"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
